purpose: Broad data acquisition backlog for Encounter Studio, Operations Lab and Hospital World
public_repository_policy: Derived research and cleared artifacts only; private chats, original transcript, credentials and restricted records excluded

domains.seed_sources: Original trials and reviews linked in clinical-research.md and project-research-synthesis.md
domains.required_output: Study design, population, comparator, outcome, limitations, applicability

domains.seed_sources: SAEM/CDEM; AAMC teaching references; mentor process review
domains.required_output: Observable supervised-student actions, sources, escalation and uncertainty

domains.seed_sources: TwinVerse eight synthetic profiles; eight faculty seed rows; original faculty cases; MedEdPORTAL leads
domains.required_output: Fixed facts, patient knowledge, explicit unknowns, objectives, disclosure and review
blocking_gaps: Profile/CSV reconciliation and clinical approval required

domains.seed_sources: Acquired organizer seven-domain 1–4/N/A rubric; faculty objectives; original instrument publications
domains.required_output: Objective-level observable evidence, accepted alternatives, review flags
blocking_gaps: Faculty configuration and scoring agreement evaluation required

domains.domain: Labs, ECGs, imaging and prior notes
domains.seed_sources: Faculty-authored synthetic reports; individually licensed teaching assets
domains.required_output: Asset source/version/license, compatible interpretation, release condition, clinical approval
Timeline, conditions, medications, allergies, units, origin and acute-case fit
Allowed code system/version, units, field mapping, missingness; not Epic integration

domains.seed_sources: Acquired five fictional clinician personas; Sevaro fictional physician rosters; authorized role/skill process review
domains.required_output: Fictional training profiles; scope, skill compatibility, action authority
blocking_gaps: Local real staffing and role authority remain unverified

domains.domain: Units, rooms, floor plans and navigation
domains.seed_sources: Official public partial maps; authorized dimensions/CAD/BIM if later supplied
domains.required_output: Illustrative topology initially; completeness, scale, permissions, room IDs and routes
Physical/staffed/available capacity, compatibility, schedules, downtime and cleaning

domains.seed_sources: Acquired Sevaro synthetic baseline hourly consult volume; later authorized local arrival/triage/admission/transfer counts
domains.required_output: Counts by time/route, observation window, dependencies and limitations
blocking_gaps: Sevaro consult demand does not calibrate RWJUH ED arrivals

domains.seed_sources: Authorized process timestamps/aggregate histograms; published DES as methods leads
domains.required_output: Stage definitions, distributions, quantiles, censoring and sample sizes

domains.seed_sources: Acquired Sevaro synthetic rosters, credentialing and coverage requirements; later approved local shift aggregates/policies
domains.required_output: Planned versus actual shifts, skills, floating eligibility, shared services, prerequisites
blocking_gaps: Cross-track reuse expectations and local staffing data unresolved

domains.domain: Insurance, cost, quality and access context
domains.seed_sources: Vlada catalog; appropriate official CMS/public sources
Acquired Sevaro synthetic hospital guides and source-conflict examples; AHRQ/TeamSTEPPS; later institutional decision rules
domains.required_output: Authority, action delay/prerequisites, tradeoffs, approved scenario objectives
blocking_gaps: Synthetic guides are not real hospital protocols

domains.seed_sources: Acquired Sevaro synthetic retrieval questions and replay snapshots; planned encounter transcripts/reviewer ratings; later authorized holdout observations
domains.required_output: Expected/observed fact IDs, disclosure and evidence checks, uncertainty, separate validity dossiers
blocking_gaps: Sevaro reference examples do not validate clinical encounters

status_note: Input acquisition is separate from Luna workflow execution and clinical approval. Later organizer resources supersede initial missing-case-input entries.
